lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Thanks for making the time, Dana. I'm Sam from Northstar Consulting.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Happy to. We want to rebuild the public booking website from the ground up.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We'll deliver the full booking flow: search for a car, reserve it, and email a receipt.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Search has to filter by pickup location, dates and car class.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yes, location, dates and car class filters are part of search.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: We run three brands: Hertz, Dollar and Thrifty. We don't want three separate codebases.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: We'll build one shared component library that serves all three brands with their own themes.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: And the site has to be responsive, phones and desktops at minimum.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Responsive layouts for small and large screens are standard for us.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Let's talk timing next call. Thanks, Sam.
